query:
SELECT mf."mediaId"
           FROM media_files mf
           WHERE mf."mediaId" = ANY($1)
           GROUP BY mf."mediaId"
           UNION
           SELECT s."mediaId"
           FROM media_files mf
           JOIN items e ON e.id = mf."episodeId"
           JOIN item_groups s ON s.id = e."groupId"
           WHERE s."mediaId" = ANY($1)
           GROUP BY s."mediaId"
